mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250) triggers central bank tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 250, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST rise, or the interaction effect (RSAFS*HOUST) has a Rank IC below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0), tight labor markets support wage growth and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC for the regime falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market boom (HOUST > 1250) signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST > 1250, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) indicates stagflationary risks, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 250 AND FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or the interaction effect (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) has a Rank IC below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS > 150000) indicates rising employment and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS > 150000, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
